description:
Manage Focus designations with the following actions:

- **bulk-create-workspace**: Bulk Create Workspace Designations. (data: payload*{designations*})
- **bulk-delete-workspace**: Bulk Delete Workspace Designations. (data: all_or_none, ids*)
- **bulk-update-workspace**: Bulk Update Workspace Designations. (data: payload*{designations*, all_or_none})
- **create-workspace**: Create Workspace Designations. (data: payload*{name*, member_ids})
- **delete-workspace**: Delete Workspace Designations. (data: designation_id*)
- **get-workspace-designations**: Get Workspace Designations Designations. (data: name, order_by, page, per_page)
- **update-workspace**: Update Workspace Designations. (data: designation_id*, payload*{name*})
- **update-workspace-designation-members**: Update Workspace Designation Members Designations. (data: payload*{add, remove})

Pass the action-specific fields under `data` (required fields are marked with *).
Mutations require a confirm_token handshake: call without confirm_token first to receive a token, then call again with the token to confirm.
Optional dry_run: true validates input and returns { dry_run, operation, input } without calling the API.

action.description: One of: bulk-create-workspace, bulk-delete-workspace, bulk-update-workspace, create-workspace, delete-workspace, get-workspace-designations, update-workspace, update-workspace-designation-members

confirm_token.description: Mutation confirmation token from previous call

data.description: Action-specific payload. See each action's parameters in this tool's description; pass dry_run: true to validate it without calling the API.

name: designations
title: Designations
